The title indicates a verse hagiography concerning the elder who made an offering of incense (*dhūpa*). The text has five translations recorded across five languages on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

Across languages, DharmaNexus automatically aligns segments 3.1–3.3 with the Sanskrit *Kaṭhināvadāna* [DharmaNexus].
